description: Source file implementing record function callbacks, callback management, and thread-local/global callback handling for profiling in PyTorch's ATen library.

classes.name: GlobalCallbackManager
classes.description: Singleton managing global record function callbacks with thread-safe updates and snapshot capabilities.

classes.name: CacheEntry
classes.description: Caches active callbacks for a specific scope, supporting sampling and rebuilds.

classes.name: LocalCallbackManager
classes.description: Manages thread-local callbacks, synchronizing with global callback manager, supporting rebuilds and scope filtering.

classes.name: RecordFunction
classes.description: Represents a profiling record, managing start/end callbacks, thread IDs, and callback invocation.
